verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a public REST API with token-based quickstarts and many write endpoints (create, update and deactivate controls; upload and delete contracts; attach evidence), plus an Auditor API, rate limits, a FedRAMP server option and type-safe SDKs generated from an OpenAPI spec. Probes confirm the developer docs and llms.txt are live, so a user or agent can clearly drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (the probed common paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Get an access token and use it to list documents, policies, and evidence in your Vanta tenant, filtered by compliance framework.
Use this API to automate bulk actions, query data for custom workflows and dashboards, and bolster your security operations
Attach an evidence file to a Vanta document and submit it for review, using the Manage Vanta API.
Vanta publishes official, type-safe SDKs for the Auditor API. Each SDK is generated from the same OpenAPI specification
Upload a contract. Rate limit: 10 requests / minute.
